description: Mark a cycle learning as actioned (linking it to a task or idea) or list unactioned learnings. Use "mark" to close out a learning after you've submitted an idea or created a task for it. Use "list" to see which learnings from recent cycles still need follow-up.

action_ref.description: Reference to the action artifact — e.g. task-1234 or idea title (mode "mark" only). Optional.

action_taken.description: What action was taken on this learning (mode "mark" only).

cycle_number.description: Filter learnings by cycle number (mode "list" only). Omit to show all recent cycles.

learning_id.description: The learning ID to mark (mode "mark" only).

mode.description: "mark" to record action taken on a learning. "list" to show unactioned learnings.

name: learning_action
